abstract: OBJECTIVE: The authors report a case of mature teratoma of the middle ear in a 3-year-old girl with a 1-year history of otitis media. METHODS AND RESULTS: Radiologic investigation revealed a partially cystic lesion of the petrous portion of the right temporal bone. It produced opacification of the middle ear as well as destruction of septal air cells. The patient underwent a subtotal petrosectomy. Histologically, the tumor was composed of an intimate admixture of mature tissues representing all three germ layers, including brain, myelinated nerve trunks, skeletal muscle, bone, immature cartilage, seromucinous glands, and respiratory epithelium. Of note within the brain tissue was choroid plexus within an ependyma-lined rudimentary ventricle. Immunohistochemical studies were also performed. Twenty months after surgery, the patient was well, with complete recovery from symptoms. CONCLUSION: Teratomas of the middle ear are rare neoplasms. Only a few examples have been reported. As a rule, they are cured by resection and do not require adjuvant therapy.
abstract_ja: 目的：3歳女児に生じた中耳の成熟奇形腫の症例を報告する。方法および結果：1年間の中耳炎の既往を有する3歳女児。画像検査で右側側頭骨錐体部の部分的嚢胞性病変を認め、中耳の混濁と気房隔壁の破壊を伴っていた。患者は亜全錐体切除術を受けた。組織学的に、腫瘍は脳、有髄神経幹、骨格筋、骨、未熟軟骨、漿液粘液腺、呼吸上皮を含む、三胚葉すべての成熟組織が密に混在した構成であった。脳組織内には、上衣に覆われた原始的な脳室内に脈絡叢が認められた。免疫組織化学的検査も実施した。術後20か月の時点で、患者は症状が完全に回復し良好であった。結論：中耳の奇形腫は稀な腫瘍であり、報告例はわずかである。原則として切除により治癒し、補助療法は不要である。
